candidate_set: final iteration of exact frozen six-iteration CUDA MPPI planner, 512 candidates per state; no planner action modified
categories: no contact 0; low 0<F<0.5F_lim; near 0.5F_lim<=F<=F_lim; above F>F_lim
planner_state_selection: four distinct validation seeds spread evenly through the category-eligible seed list; within each seed use the median previous-force state
selection_comparison: same-candidate argmax only, not a rerun or replacement of MPPI optimized-mean action
